name: Minimal DSGC with Scalar gabaMOD
short_description: Pure-Python NEURON library for a minimal direction-selective ganglion cell with 100 co-located E+I synapses, scalar gabaMOD inhibition, and a 12-direction moving-bar trial runner.

entry_points.name: build_dsgc_from_swc
entry_points.description: Parse a calibrated SWC, collapse the soma into one Section, build one h.Section per non-soma compartment, attach a synthetic axon initial segment, and return a CellHandles dataclass.

entry_points.name: sample_dendritic_locations
entry_points.description: Sample N dendritic locations uniformly along total dendritic length using numpy.random.default_rng(seed).

entry_points.name: build_ei_pairs
entry_points.description: Construct one AMPA + GABA Exp2Syn pair per Location, each driven by a single-event NetStim+NetCon.

entry_points.name: schedule_ei_onsets
entry_points.description: Per-trial scheduler: set NetStim.start times from the bar-leading-edge crossing geometry and apply gabaMOD scaling to GABA NetCon weights.

entry_points.name: gaba_mod
entry_points.description: Scalar gabaMOD multiplier: returns 0.33 at preferred direction (theta=0) and 0.99 at null direction (theta=180).

entry_points.name: TrialMode
entry_points.description: StrEnum with members FULL, AMPA_ONLY, GABA_ONLY for selecting which synaptic drive is active.

entry_points.name: run_one_trial
entry_points.description: Run one trial: schedule onsets, apply mode-specific weight overrides, finitialize+continuerun, return TrialResult with V(t), spike times, and synapse onset times.

entry_points.name: run_full_sweep
entry_points.description: End-to-end 12 directions x 10 trials x 3 modes = 360-trial sweep with dry-run validation gate; writes per-mode tuning-curve / spike-time / voltage-trace CSVs and an activation-time CSV.

entry_points.name: compute_vector_sum_dsi
entry_points.description: Vector-sum DSI from the per-angle mean firing rates: |sum r_k * exp(i theta_k)| / sum r_k.

entry_points.name: compute_preferred_direction_deg
entry_points.description: Preferred direction in degrees from the complex sum of rate-weighted unit vectors.

entry_points.name: compute_metrics_main
entry_points.description: Compute per-mode metrics (DSI, HWHM, reliability, vector-sum DSI, preferred direction, IPSP ratio) and write metrics.json + derived_quantities.json with a hard IPSP-ratio sanity check.

entry_points.name: render_figures_main
entry_points.description: Render all per-direction figures (soma V, EPSP, IPSP, PSTH, activation histograms) plus polar and Cartesian tuning curves.
